discrepancies.note: λ = 3.46 l0/h with l0 = 3.1 m and h = 0.5 m is 21.5; the report prints 22.5. Neither value changes the slender verdict against λ_lim = 11.5.
e_i is computed as θ_i l/2 with the actual height 4 m; 5.2(7) (5.2) uses the effective length l0 (θ_i l0/2 = 7.75 mm).

e2 = 14 mm follows from 0.25 d in the curvature denominator; (5.34) is 1/r0 = ε_yd/(0.45 d), which with the report's K_r = 0.62, K_φ = 1.14 and d = 454 mm gives about 7.3 mm for l0 = 3.1 m (7.8 mm with the 3.2 m the report substitutes).
The report takes e0 = b/20 = 25 mm; 6.1(4) gives e0 = h/30 = 16.7 mm, not less than 20 mm.
